protocol.camera_protocol: TUM recommended ROS-default registered PNG convention, 525/525/319.5/239.5; depth /5000, no extra depth scaling
protocol.selection: Lowest development macro pose-log-error among candidates passing all depth/boundary guards; fallback RAW. Freeze before heldout inference.
protocol.evaluation: Per-frame depth/boundary, per-pair common-mask Farneback + independent RAFT, GT-only pose reprojection, no GT scale fitting. No frame-level significance claims.
protocol.timing: Fusion-only, flow-inclusive postprocessing and warmed offline RGB-file-to-compressed-depth pipeline measured separately; 1 warmup + 3 repeats, batch VDA is not streaming latency.

selection.reason: Development only; minimum pose error among guarded candidates; no heldout input to selection
